name: io.github.jefflitt1/health4ai
title: health4ai
description: Query your Apple Health data from your own Supabase/Postgres via local MCP.

environmentVariables.name: DATABASE_URL
environmentVariables.description: Postgres connection string for your Supabase project (transaction pooler; database password, not a service-role key).

environmentVariables.name: HEALTHKIT_USER_ID
environmentVariables.description: UUID of the Supabase Auth user whose HealthKit data to query.
